channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Creative couple Aneal and Travis are searching for a lakefront home that sparks inspiration and is perfect for entertaining; from a modern-rustic retreat with a sleek kitchen and private wellness center, to a cozy cabin with vaulted ceilings and a dreamy dockside yard, to a minimalist hideaway with 250 feet of waterfront, which home will turn their vision of the perfect lake life into reality?
